title: Kissed, Fluffy Mexican Poblano Pozole
description: Briny, fluffy, lazy-sunday Mexican dish featuring brown rice noodle, deglaze
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and cook the onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the poblano peppers and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly charred.
Add the corn, vegetable broth, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Cook the brown rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
To assemble, place a portion of noodles in a bowl, then ladle the pozole over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of salt, if desired.
Serve immediately, with extra cilantro and lime wedges on the side.
